name: ListenBrainz

http.reason: 提交播放记录与正在播放通知

description: Reports scrobbles and now-playing notifications to a ListenBrainz account via /1/submit-listens (single listens with listened_at, playing_now with progress), including MusicBrainz identifiers in additional_info. Needs a user token from listenbrainz.org/settings/musicbrainz; saving it validates the token against /1/validate-token. Tracks shorter than 30 seconds are skipped.
author: TMA

en.description: Reports scrobbles and now-playing notifications to a ListenBrainz account via /1/submit-listens (single listens with listened_at, playing_now with progress), including MusicBrainz identifiers in additional_info. Needs a user token from listenbrainz.org/settings/musicbrainz; saving it validates the token against /1/validate-token. Tracks shorter than 30 seconds are skipped.
en.user_config.token.title: User token
en.user_config.token.description: ListenBrainz user token (listenbrainz.org → Settings → MusicBrainz). Stored encrypted and never echoed back.
en.actions.authorize.label: Authorize

zh.description: 把播放记录与正在播放通知上报到 ListenBrainz 账户：经 /1/submit-listens 提交（scrobble 带 listened_at，正在播放带进度），additional_info 附带 MusicBrainz 标识。需要 listenbrainz.org → Settings → MusicBrainz 里的用户 token；保存时经 /1/validate-token 校验有效性。不足 30 秒的曲目跳过。
